question: Whether improved lithium/portfolio operating conditions and Kemerton Train 1 remaining idled for insufficient conversion economics are mutually contradictory on the current source-addressed record.
whyItMatters: ALB is the sole visible Resolver frontier item and packet_ready is blocked only by unresolved_material_contradiction; a lawful scope adjudication can close the nearest frontier without taking over Alpha underwriting.
lawfulFallbacks: Preserve Kemerton conversion-economics weakness as material non-gating risk
Return awaiting_new_evidence only if a newer primary source creates a mutually exclusive Kemerton-level claim
successCondition: Determine whether current source-addressed evidence makes the claims mutually exclusive or demonstrates different economic scopes.
resolution: The claims are not mutually exclusive. Current Alpha underwriting source-addresses company/Energy Storage operating improvement and separately source-addresses Kemerton idling, explicitly using Kemerton as evidence that resource scale does not guarantee durable conversion economics. Portfolio/segment recovery can therefore coexist with asset-specific downstream conversion weakness. The contradiction is resolved as a scope distinction; preserve lithium-price sensitivity, Kemerton conversion-cost disadvantage, restart uncertainty and physical-ramp risk as material non-gating risks. Do not infer that portfolio recovery proves Kemerton economics.
falsifiers: New primary evidence showing Kemerton Train 1 was economically viable on the same assumptions and period yet remained idled for a mutually exclusive stated reason
Evidence showing the cited profitability improvement was specifically Kemerton-level rather than Energy Storage/portfolio-level
repeatedBlocker: Routing re-emitted the same ALB scope contradiction after two prior Resolver adjudications even though the latest Alpha record corroborates the scope distinction.
failedStrategy: Repeated re-adjudication of the same scope distinction after materially similar inputs produced no durable routing closure.
changedStrategy: Applied the anti-repeat boundary: adjudicated only the current independently actionable packet item against the latest source-addressed Alpha record and prior falsifiers, then records this as the final Resolver disposition unless a materially new independently actionable source changes the claim pair.
